name: Education AI Workflow - Microsoft 365 Production Blueprint
warning: This is NOT a Power Automate solution export. Build in an authorized tenant after permission, licensing and DLP checks.
prerequisites: Microsoft 365 work/school mailbox with Outlook connector access
Power Automate environment with standard connector permissions
SharePoint List available and accessible with delegated permissions
Approvals connector and Dataverse dependencies allowed by policy
DLP permits intended Outlook / SharePoint / To Do / Approvals connector combinations
Data classification and retention policy approved by school/education authority

flows.name: Email intake
flows.trigger: Office 365 Outlook: When a new email arrives (V3)
actions: classify metadata without leaking sensitive content
if deadline verified: Microsoft To-Do (Business) Add a to-do (V3)

flows.name: Deadline alerts
flows.trigger: Recurrence daily 09:00 and 14:00, Tokyo Standard Time
actions: compute D-3 / D-1 / D0 / overdue stages

flows.name: Document compliance checklist
flows.trigger: SharePoint: When a file is created or modified
actions: check file metadata and checklist version

flows.name: Regulation evidence gate
actions: check regulation version and evidence refs

flows.name: HR evidence assist
actions: hold restricted release for authorized manager

flows.name: Meeting options
actions: Get calendar view of events (V3) for authorized calendars

flows.name: Approval gateway
actions: Start and wait for an approval when under 30-day run limit
execute only allowed approved side effect

forbidden: processing private personnel files in unapproved consumer AI
